# Carlos review script dependencies.
# All three LLM SDKs are installed regardless of which PROVIDER a repo picks —
# they're small, and it keeps the workflow's install step provider-agnostic.
# Only the SDK matching PROVIDER is ever imported/called at runtime
# (see llm_providers.py), so an unused provider's package just sits idle.

json-repair==0.30.3
google-genai==0.7.0
openai==1.54.4
anthropic==0.39.0
